name: MARVIN turn-handler (USER-STACK / self-hosted TTS) - dhaibuilds DZ7kMxgMboD

parameters.content:
User naming: this assistant is MARVIN; the source calls it MARVIN. Preserve source evidence separately.

## User-stack variant
Same method as the VIDEO version, but the paid ElevenLabs TTS call is replaced with self-hosted openai-edge-tts.

Verified tool: https://github.com/travisvn/openai-edge-tts (2026-09-23). OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/audio/speech on port 5050, auth 'Authorization: Bearer <key>', body {model,input,voice,response_format,speed}, returns audio. License GPL-3.0.

### Why it helps (corrected)
No per-character billing to ElevenLabs and self-hostable on your own port -> lower cost and simpler high-volume use. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: it is NOT offline. Per its README, edge-tts relies on Microsoft Edge's ONLINE text-to-speech service ('completely free' per README, but internet-dependent, no SLA, and Microsoft may rate-limit/change it). Do not treat it as guaranteed free/unlimited/offline.

### Honest tradeoff
openai-edge-tts uses Microsoft Edge neural voices; it does NOT reproduce a cloned 'Marvin' ElevenLabs voice. Choose the VIDEO version when a specific cloned voice identity matters.

### Setup state (PENDING)
openai-edge-tts must be running before this produces audio: e.g. `docker run -d -p 5050:5050 -e API_KEY=changeme travisvn/openai-edge-tts`. Requires internet for the Microsoft backend. Bind the Bearer key as an httpHeaderAuth credential. Not runtime-tested here.
